tasks.short: Perform school support and supervision duties

steps.what: Read the duty assignment and relevant pupil support or safety instructions
Assist pupils in the school library and handle physical library materials
Record actual library loans and returns in the circulation system
Perform hall and cafeteria monitoring and respond to pupil safety needs
Supervise safe bus loading and unloading
Write the required factual note when a reportable duty incident occurs

tasks.design: Use the native duty view in {DOCS}, existing barcode entry in the {OTHER} library circulation system and a short native incident form in the {OTHER} pupil records system. The teacher retains all physical assistance and supervision, records actual loans and returns separately, and writes an incident note only where the existing reporting practice requires it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual library-record searches and repeated context entry add small amounts of administrative work around physical duties.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing library identifiers and native forms may remove repeated searching and duplicate duty-context entry.
tasks.still_hard: Noticing unsafe situations and responding to pupils in real time.
tasks.human_edge: Protecting pupils through presence, judgement and proportionate intervention.
tasks.altitude: A small reduction in record handling; pupil supervision and responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.task: Maintain correct loan and return records during pupil assistance

evidence.claim: Native circulation barcode entry, a consolidated duty view and editable incident forms are model knowledge designs; the digest does not measure this school-duty workflow.

assumptions: Boundary includes the mix of duties the teacher actually performs, including real circulation entries and required incident notes. The shares are an aggregate across those duty periods, not a claim that every library visit or bus duty produces an incident. No routine monitoring log or additional pupil record is invented.

Duty coordinators supply duty location, time and relevant safety instructions in the existing assignment; s1 counts reading and checking. The teacher observes actual pupil needs and incidents during s2, s4 and s5, with all physical and interaction time retained. No structured incident or risk flag is assumed to appear without observation.

The {OTHER} categories are the library circulation system and the pupil records system. The pupil and physical item provide existing library IDs; s3 retains 6 hours for scanning or manual capture, identity confirmation and exceptions. Missing barcodes require native manual lookup and earn no automatic benefit.

For actual reportable incidents, the teacher produces event time, location, involved pupils, observed facts and immediate action in s6, retaining 4 hours for capture and factual checking. The native form only reuses duty context; it does not infer behaviour, seriousness or safeguarding decisions.

Test native duty views, existing scanners and incident templates first. Where circulation is already efficient there is no new scanning benefit. Same-system author saves have no gate or saving, and access by safeguarding staff does not imply an additional automated send.
unknowns: Current library lookup and barcode practices
Which incidents require a record and how much factual note writing occurs
Existing teacher access to circulation and pupil-record forms
research_questions: Do actual duty observations reveal avoidable lookup and duplicate field entry after preserving all supervision and factual note time?

already_counted.description: Read duty instructions, confirm circulation entries and write required incident facts

incremental.description: Maintain native form defaults and check access and incorrect identifier reuse

approvals.approved_version: The teacher's current pupil-specific library assistance and physical handover
The live pupil-safety intervention in the observed hall or cafeteria situation; changing circumstances require fresh judgement
The actual pupil and bus movement under current observed loading conditions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=94, gross=6, upkeep=0.5, net=5.5. Cautious case: an already short duty brief and barcode-based circulation retain all 5 and 10 hours, while uncommon incident forms retain 4.5 of 5 hours; all 80 physical-duty hours stay, giving 0.5 gross minus 0.5 upkeep =0. High 3 requires genuine manual lookup and duplicate context entry while retaining more exceptions than central.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The teacher spends slightly less time handling existing records while keeping all pupil-facing support and supervision.
reach: Handle routine circulation exceptions with library staff
skills_to_grow: Checking what native forms actually remove
role.ambitious_version: Reliable support records without reducing adult presence where pupils need it.
